thread:
Sam: Heads up — invoice-preview for tenant=acme-inc jumped ~18% around 03:30UTC. Console shows a huge spike in 'unattributed tokens' and the preview tool is timing out for some customers. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:
Rhea: saw an alert too, spotted in the nightly audit. preview-delta alarm fired. looks related to the ingestion re-roll last night?
Noah: yup, we pushed the ingest window change to 1h (was 5m) to reduce churn during peak. I suspected late-joiners might be impacted but didn't expect this magnitude.
Elaine: quick question — are these duplicates or genuinely late events that we hadn't counted before? BillingBot: (automated) Detected 4k events with duplicate fingerprint + uncommitted ledger rows in the 03:00-04:00 window.
Sam: BillingBot results point at duplicate fingerprints. My hunch: routing proxy replay + longer agg window allowed the same session to be counted twice across aggregation flush boundaries.
Rhea: the console preview sampling is truncating event streams so duplicates are hidden — UX makes it look like new tokens instead of replays. we should surface event IDs in the preview.
Noah: quick repro snippet from aggregator logic:```sql
-- pseudo
with events as (
  select fingerprint, min(received_ts) as first_seen, count(*) as cnt
  from raw_events
  where received_ts >= '2026-03-20T03:00:00Z'
  group by fingerprint
)
select fingerprint, first_seen, cnt from events order by cnt desc limit 10;
```
Noah: currently dedupe key = fingerprint + window_bucket(received_ts, 1 hour). replay across boundary can duplicate.
Elaine: options: 1) shorten the aggregation window back to 5m (quick rollback) 2) adopt watermark per-tenant so aggregator uses event.emitted_ts stable anchor 3) add idempotency token propagation at proxy (longer term)
Liz: UX ask — if we do a rollback can we expose a rollback/canary toggle in Console for the metering window so Support can toggle per-tenant without a deploy?
Noah: we can wire a feature-flag in the control plane; we already have the meter-window flag in infra — but no per-tenant override in Console today. adding per-tenant toggle is ~2-3 sprint effort.
Sam: immediate mitigations I propose: short rollback to 5m (fast), enable extra logging & sampling on affected tenants, and patch aggregator to prefer emitted_ts for dedupe when available.
Elaine: +1. Also add a debug trace in the preview UI that shows event_id and fingerprint (collapsed by default) so support can triage without pulling logs.
Rhea: for telemetry/dashboards: create a new timeseries 'metering.dup_rate' = duplicates / total_events and add alert if > 1% for 15m. Also add 'invoice-preview-delta' to the tenant-level dashboard.
InfraBot: (automated) Canary deploy policy recommends rolling back config changes if error_rate > 0.5% within 30m of change. Current change was 1h ago.
Noah: rollout plan: revert window in infra canary to 5m for all tenants for next 30m, observe dup_rate and invoice delta. If stable, we investigate a safer migration path with watermarking.
Liz: for Console UX backlog: file a ticket to add per-tenant metering toggle + preview debug panel. I'll own the ticket.
Sam: I'll open the rollback PR now and add the emitted_ts dedupe patch as a follow-up. tagging @Rhea to watch the dashboards and @Elaine to coordinate preview UX.
Rhea: following. will create the dup_rate dashboard card and wire the alert.
Elaine: will mock the preview debug panel and post screenshots here once ready.
Sam: thanks — good triage. post follow-ups in this thread and let's aim to ship the rollback in the next 15m. :rocket:
